description: The cars card calls this tool to load the next five cars of a search. The assistant does not call it.

bodyType.description: Optional. The body style. A truck is Pickup.

condition.description: Optional. Whether the buyer wants new or used cars. When given, it applies to every model year. Left out, the search covers new cars when no model year is given or the model year is the current one or later, and both new and used cars for an older model year.

drivetrain.description: Optional. A drivetrain to look for.

exteriorColor.description: Optional. The buyer's own words for the exterior color. A color family, such as White or Gray, matches more cars than a dealer's color name.

fuel.description: Optional. The fuel type, exactly one of: Gasoline, Hybrid, Plug-In Hybrid, Electric, Diesel. A gas car is Gasoline, not Gas. The model and trim fields ignore a fuel type. Left out, the search covers every fuel, hybrid and electric cars included. The search keeps no earlier choice, so a fuel the buyer already chose is sent again.

interiorColor.description: Optional. The buyer's own words for the interior color. A color family, such as Black or Gray, matches more cars than a dealer's color name.

maxDaysOnMarket.description: Optional. The most days the car has been listed.

maxMileage.description: Optional. The most miles on the car, from 0 to 200000.

maxPrice.description: Optional. The highest listed price in whole dollars, from 0 to 150000.

maxYear.description: Optional. The newest model year. Not sent with year.

minPrice.description: Optional. The lowest listed price in whole dollars, from 0 to 150000.

minYear.description: Optional. The oldest model year, from 2000. Not sent with year.

model.description: The model, for example Telluride. The model name only; a fuel type goes in fuel.

page.description: Which five cars of the search, from 1 to 4.

radius.description: Optional. Miles from the buyer's ZIP, from 1 to 100. When no radius is given, the search starts at 25 miles. When fewer than five cars match, it widens to 50 miles, then to 100. A radius that is given is used as given.

sort.description: Optional. The order of the cars. Left out, the order is not by price or distance.

trim.description: Optional. A trim to look for. A fuel type goes in fuel.

year.description: Optional. A model year. Left out, the search covers every model year.

name: see_cars_near_buyer_page
title: Load more cars
